units.source_text: 九月十七日上午十点三十分，我等十七名会员与灵学会会长培喀先生，偕同我等最信任的灵媒赫卟夫人，齐聚该工作室。

en.t: At ten thirty in the morning on September seventeenth, the seventeen of us members gathered in that studio with Mr. Peka, president of the Society for Spiritual Studies, and with Mrs. Hepp, the medium we trusted most.

units.source_text: 赫卟夫人刚一走进屋里，马上感触到鬼气，随即全身痉挛，呕吐不已。

en.t: As soon as Mrs. Hepp entered the room, she sensed a ghostly presence, and at once her whole body went into spasms and she could not stop vomiting.

units.source_text: 根据夫人所称，这是因为诗人托喀君生前嗜好吸烟，他的鬼气里也含有尼古丁云云。

en.t: According to the lady, this was because the poet Toka had been fond of smoking while alive, so even his ghostly aura contained nicotine, or so she said.
